issues.description: The problem statement contains an internal contradiction about the type of the Animal.name attribute: the UML shows the attribute as type String, while the textual instructions explicitly require using StringBuilder for the name. This conflicting guidance can confuse students about which type to use when implementing Animal and its getter/setter.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the specification: either update the UML to show name: StringBuilder or remove/adjust the textual instruction so it matches the UML (name: String). Make a single clear authoritative statement about the attribute type so students know which type to implement.

issues.description: The solution implementation of Animal uses a String type for the name field, whereas the problem statement's textual instructions require using StringBuilder for the name attribute. This mismatch between specification and solution may mislead students and cause confusion when comparing their implementation to the provided solution/reference.
issues.suggestedFix: Either adjust the solution/reference to use StringBuilder for the Animal.name field (and adapt constructor/getter/setter accordingly), or change the problem statement to require a String name (remove the StringBuilder requirement). Ensure tests and example code (Main) are updated to match the chosen type.
